title: Coordination of Linden Memberships with Insurance and the Patient Financial Account
content:
Linden Memberships combine with the Patient Financial Account as follows.

## Statement

1. **Tiers whose member visits are not billed to insurance.** Where the tier does not bill member visits to insurance (the Linden Essential Membership and the Linden Family Membership), member primary care visits are not billed to insurance and carry no copay.
2. **Tiers whose member visits are billed to insurance.** Where the tier bills member visits to insurance, member visits are billed to the patient's insurance and the copay is collected under the rules of the Patient Financial Account, because a membership never waives an insurer's cost share.
3. **Services always billed normally.** Specialist visits, imaging, procedures and outside labs are always billed normally.
4. **Member discounts.** Members receive the tier's lab panel discount and imaging discount only on self-paid in-house services.
5. **Referrals and authorizations.** The membership does not change referral or authorization requirements, although where the tier includes care coordination a coordinator initiates them for the member.

## Branches

| Tier bills member visits to insurance | Member primary care visit | Copay |
|---|---|---|
| No (Linden Essential Membership, Linden Family Membership) | Not billed to insurance | None |
| Yes (all other tiers) | Billed to the patient's insurance | Collected under the rules of the Patient Financial Account |

| Service | Treatment under any tier |
|---|---|
| Specialist visit | Billed normally |
| Imaging, procedure, outside lab | Billed normally; the member discount applies only where the imaging or lab is a self-paid in-house service |
| Referral or authorization requirement | Unchanged by the membership |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A Linden Plus Membership member has a primary care office visit. The visit is billed to the member's insurance and the copay is collected; the membership does not waive it.
- A Linden Family Membership member has a primary care office visit. It is not billed to insurance and no copay applies.
- A Linden Essential Membership member sees a specialist. The specialist visit is billed normally, as for any patient.
- A member pays for an in-house lab panel themselves. The tier's lab panel discount applies. The same panel sent to an outside lab is billed normally.
- A member on a tier with care coordination needs a referral. The referral requirement is unchanged; a coordinator initiates it for the member.
